allow: PowerShell(foreach \($c in 'python','python3','py','ollama','dotnet','node','npm','git','gh','pwsh','swift'\) { $p = \(Get-Command $c -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\); if \($p\) { "{0} -> {1}" -f $c, $p.Source } else { "$c -> MISSING" } }; "---"; $env:PATH)

PowerShell(dotnet --list-sdks; "---"; ollama list; "---"; \(Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem\).TotalPhysicalMemory/1GB; "---"; python --version; python -c "import openai" 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 3)
PowerShell($models = @\('qwen3:4b','qwen3:0.6b','gemma3:1b','llama3.2:1b','gemma2:2b'\); foreach \($m in $models\) { Write-Output "== pulling $m =="; ollama pull $m 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1 })
